messages:
emma: Incident bot just paged me — canary in us-west is seeing a healthcheck spike and elevated 5xx. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: [ALERT] canary-healthcheck-failures (us-west) — 5xx rate 18% over baseline for 3m. Triggered threshold: abort-canary.
pan: seeing same in grafana, canary pool shows 503s on /v1/generate and liveness checks failing on 2 hosts. p95 latency up ~400ms.
rick: likely culprit is the latest fastpath change (PR #4821) — that landed into canary last deploy. Repro locally with seq len 512 shows timeout when kv-prefetch hits a backend race.
maya: support: any visible customer 5xx spikes? We have two customers in us-west reporting degraded streaming responses. Need a quick customer impact note.
emma: Maya — tell support tier1: "We're seeing degraded responses in us-west canary, rolling back canary and enabling kill-switch. We'll update in 15m."
rick: recommend immediate action: 1) flip canary feature flag off, 2) scale canary down to 0, 3) rollback to previous model runtime.
pan: agreed. also add temporary routing rule to avoid us-west region for new sessions during the rollback window.
emma: I'll take lead. Initiating feature flag kill-switch now.
emma: /run runbook "canary-kill-switch" // (manual step)
deploy-bot: Executing kill-switch: setting flag inference.fastpath.canary=false for org-wide rollout. status: queued -> success.
emma: Flag flipped. Confirming traffic shift beginning.
pan: starting targeted routing change in envoy: set header-based route to avoid canary tags for new sessions.
rick: starting rollback to previous release on canary subset. Command:```kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-canary --to-revision=42```
deploy-bot: Rollback started for deployment inference-canary -> target revision 42. Watch pods.
pan: pods terminating and new replicas coming up. healthchecks now 1/3 failing -> 0/3 for one pod then healthy.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] alert suppressed by action: abort-canary rule fired and mitigation in progress.
maya: I'm posting a customer update: "We've detected and mitigated an intermittent canary issue in us-west affecting a small subset of traffic. Engineers have rolled back the canary and toggled the feature flag; service recovery is in progress. We'll follow up with details once root cause is confirmed."
emma: Confirming metrics: 5xx rate trending down in last 2 minutes from 18% -> 4% on canary cohort; overall service p95 latency normalizing.
rick: will open a follow-up PR to revert fastpath race and add extra prefetch guards + integration test.
pan: temporary mitigation checklist done. Leaving postmortem/alert to on-call rotation. Handing off to next oncall for root cause and follow-up.
emma: handing to @rick for RCA and @pan for monitoring followups. If anything regresses, page team immediately.
maya: Noted; I've updated the customer ticket and added the timeline.
emma: closing on-call thread for immediate mitigation. Last logs attached to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
